properties.notes: A terrace of mews houses comprising 5No. 3B houses and a set of 2No. 4B semi-detached houses at the end of Radlett Close facing the southern side of Atherton Mews. The proposals include a total of 15 parking spaces and associated landscaping, refuse and cycle storage.
